title: Zoom in: health checks decide who gets traffic
caption: Active probes catch dead instances; real traffic (passive checks) catches slow or erroring ones. Thresholds stop one blip from flapping an instance.

messages.label: GET /healthz
messages.note: Every 5 s the proxy probes each instance.

messages.label: no reply (2 s)
messages.note: Instance 2 is stuck in a GC pause or deadlock. One miss is not enough to act.

messages.label: GET /healthz ×2
messages.note: Two more misses in a row: 3 failures over ~15 s.

messages.label: eject Checkout 2
messages.note: Unhealthy threshold reached: no new requests go to it.

messages.label: all /api/cart traffic
messages.note: Checkout 1 takes the whole load: the pool needs N+1 headroom.

scenarios.name: Recovery + slow start
scenarios.summary: Re-admit after several passes, then ramp traffic up over ~30 s so a cold instance isn't knocked over again.

messages.label: GET /healthz
messages.note: Probes continue while it is ejected.

messages.label: GET /healthz
messages.note: Healthy threshold: 2 passes in a row.

messages.label: re-admit, weight 10%
messages.note: Slow start: its share grows to normal over ~30 s while caches warm.

scenarios.name: Risk: deep check cascade
scenarios.summary: A health check that pings the database fails on every instance at once when the DB blips: the LB ejects the whole pool. Keep liveness shallow, and fail open when all are unhealthy.

messages.label: GET /healthz
messages.note: This check also runs SELECT 1 on the database.

messages.label: SELECT 1
messages.note: The database has a 10 s failover.
Every instance fails for the same shared reason.

messages.label: eject all → 100% errors
messages.note: Ejecting everyone turns a 10 s DB blip into a full outage. Mitigation: shallow /healthz, plus panic mode that keeps routing when all instances look unhealthy.

scenarios.name: Passive outlier check
scenarios.summary: Watch real responses instead of probes: an instance with 5 straight 5xx is ejected within seconds, even if /healthz still says 200.

messages.note: Its disk is full: /healthz still passes, real requests fail.

messages.label: eject Checkout 2 for 30 s
messages.note: Outlier detection: ejection time grows each time it happens again.
